title: CENTCOM bottleneck on UAP information

tellings.quote: Central Command has a bottleneck to UAP information before it gets to the people

plain: The filmmaker and journalist Jeremy Corbell says that US Central Command, the military command in charge of the Middle East, is a bottleneck for reports of UAP. UAP stands for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs. He says the command holds the information up before it reaches the public, and ties the claim to reporting he has done with the television journalist George Knapp.
